title: A Standard Quantum Mechanical Treatment to Rationalize the Delayed-Choice Quantum Eraser
summary: Ever since the proposal of delayed choice quantum erasure and subsequent realization in the experiment by Kim et al., the interpretation and implications of delayed-choice experiments have remained a subject of intense foundational debate. This paper resolves the apparent paradox attached to the experiment using standard quantum mechanics.
